svg.text: RadeQ.cz - website palettes for logo variant B
Logo direction: dark walnut / cream / copper. Goal: practical IT trust, not neon AI styling.
Claude + GPT + Gemini converge on walnut base, copper as action color, and a cooler secondary tone for technical context.

g.text: recommended for website - best balance of IT trust, warmth and contrast
warmest direction - more personal, less corporate, still practical
most technical - stronger database, AI and system-work signal
strongest premium - more authority, less playfulness, excellent dark mode

svg.text: Implementation note: do not use copper for long body text. Use it for buttons, links, icons, highlights, and status details.
